name: QuestionPro
description_en:
QuestionPro is a product in the Surveys and feedback category. Its directory profile covers Skip Logic, Survey Templates, Support Audio / Images / Video, Site Intercept Survey, Question Library, Question Branching, Online Survey, Offline Response Collection.

Additional listed capabilities include Multiple Question Types, Mobile Survey, Kiosk Survey, Embeddable Survey, Email Distribution, Data Analysis Tools, Custom Survey URLs, 360 Degree Feedback. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $129.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: choose subsequent questions using earlier answers; set supported survey addresses for sharing. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
QuestionPro 属于问卷与反馈软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括跳题逻辑、问卷模板、支持音频、图片与视频、网站拦截问卷、题目库、问题分支、在线问卷、离线问卷收集。

资料还列出多种题型、移动端问卷、自助终端问卷、可嵌入问卷、邮件分发、数据分析工具、自定义问卷链接、360 度反馈。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $129.00. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：根据前面的答案选择后续问题；设置用于分享的问卷地址。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
